assumptions: Matching OpenWrt netifd with native bonding, firewall4, dnsmasq, odhcpd and mac80211/wpad capabilities are required
Owns network, dhcp, firewall and declared wireless configuration; other system settings are preserved separately
Dynamic addresses, ISP prefix delegation, LACP peer state and radio operation are unknown
Wireless credentials require external binding; templates must not be installed directly
WDS four-address support and compatible radio negotiation are required; station BSSID identity is unknown unless an AP MAC is declared

files.content:
config globals 'globals'
	option dhcp_default_duid '0004ecf7fc0d101f44ab9683172b87cd03ad'
	option ula_prefix 'fdbe:c414:cd71:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000/48'
	option packet_steering '1'

config device 'bridge_0'
	option name 'br-lan'
	option type 'bridge'
	list ports 'lan2'
	list ports 'lan3'

config device 'bond_0'
	option name 'bond-wan'
	option type 'bonding'
	option mtu '1500'
	option macaddr 'e8:9f:80:69:cb:51'
	option policy '802.3ad'
	option xmit_hash_policy 'layer3+4'
	option ad_select 'stable'
	option lacp_rate 'fast'
	option min_links '1'
	option monitor_interval '100'
	list ports 'lan1'
	list ports 'wan'

config interface 'loopback'
	option device 'lo'
	option proto 'static'
	list ipaddr '127.0.0.1/8'

config interface 'lan'
	option device 'br-lan'
	option proto 'static'
	option ip6assign '60'
	option multipath 'off'
	list ipaddr '10.9.8.1/24'

config interface 'wan'
	option device 'bond-wan'
	option proto 'dhcp'
	option multipath 'off'

config interface 'wan6'
	option device 'bond-wan'
	option proto 'dhcpv6'
	option multipath 'off'
	option reqaddress 'try'
	option reqprefix 'auto'
	option norelease '1'

config interface 'modem'
	option device 'bond-wan'
	option proto 'static'
	option multipath 'off'
	list ipaddr '192.168.100.2/24'

config dnsmasq 'dns'
	option domainneeded '1'
	option boguspriv '1'
	option filterwin2k '0'
	option localise_queries '1'
	option rebind_protection '1'
	option rebind_localhost '1'
	option expandhosts '1'
	option nonegcache '0'
	option authoritative '1'
	option readethers '1'
	option nonwildcard '1'
	option localservice '1'
	option filter_aaaa '0'
	option filter_a '0'
	option local '/lan/'
	option domain 'lan'
	option leasefile '/tmp/dhcp.leases'
	option resolvfile '/tmp/resolv.conf.d/resolv.conf.auto'
	option cachesize '1000'
	option ednspacket_max '1232'

config dhcp 'lan'
	option interface 'lan'
	option start '100'
	option limit '100'
	option leasetime '12h'
	option dhcpv4 'server'
	option dhcpv6 'server'
	option ra 'server'
	option ra_preference 'medium'
	list ra_flags 'managed-config'
	list ra_flags 'other-config'

config dhcp 'wan'
	option interface 'wan'
	option ignore '1'

config odhcpd 'odhcpd'
	option maindhcp '0'
	option leasefile '/tmp/odhcpd.leases'
	option leasetrigger '/usr/sbin/odhcpd-update'
	option loglevel '4'
	option piodir '/tmp/odhcpd-piodir'
	option hostsdir '/tmp/hosts'

config defaults 'defaults'
	option syn_flood '1'
	option input 'REJECT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'REJECT'

config zone 'zone_0'
	option name 'lan'
	option input 'ACCEPT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'ACCEPT'
	list network 'lan'

config zone 'zone_1'
	option name 'wan'
	option input 'REJECT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'DROP'
	option masq '1'
	option mtu_fix '1'
	list network 'wan'
	list network 'wan6'
	list network 'modem'

config forwarding 'forward_0'
	option src 'lan'
	option dest 'wan'

config rule 'rule_0'
	option name 'Allow-DHCP-Renew'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'udp'
	option family 'ipv4'
	option dest_port '68'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'rule_1'
	option name 'Allow-Ping'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'icmp'
	option family 'ipv4'
	option target 'ACCEPT'
	list icmp_type 'echo-request'

config rule 'rule_2'
	option name 'Allow-IGMP'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'igmp'
	option family 'ipv4'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'rule_3'
	option name 'Allow-DHCPv6'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'udp'
	option family 'ipv6'
	option dest_port '546'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'rule_4'
	option name 'Allow-MLD'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'icmp'
	option src_ip 'fe80:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000/10'
	option family 'ipv6'
	option target 'ACCEPT'
	list icmp_type '130/0'
	list icmp_type '131/0'
	list icmp_type '132/0'
	list icmp_type '143/0'

config rule 'rule_5'
	option name 'Allow-ICMPv6-Input'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'icmp'
	option family 'ipv6'
	option limit '1000/sec'
	option target 'ACCEPT'
	list icmp_type 'echo-request'
	list icmp_type 'echo-reply'
	list icmp_type 'destination-unreachable'
	list icmp_type 'packet-too-big'
	list icmp_type 'time-exceeded'
	list icmp_type 'bad-header'
	list icmp_type 'unknown-header-type'
	list icmp_type 'router-solicitation'
	list icmp_type 'neighbour-solicitation'
	list icmp_type 'router-advertisement'
	list icmp_type 'neighbour-advertisement'

config rule 'rule_6'
	option name 'Allow-ICMPv6-Forward'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'icmp'
	option dest '*'
	option family 'ipv6'
	option limit '1000/sec'
	option target 'ACCEPT'
	list icmp_type 'echo-request'
	list icmp_type 'echo-reply'
	list icmp_type 'destination-unreachable'
	list icmp_type 'packet-too-big'
	list icmp_type 'time-exceeded'
	list icmp_type 'bad-header'
	list icmp_type 'unknown-header-type'

config rule 'rule_7'
	option name 'Allow-IPSec-ESP'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'esp'
	option dest 'lan'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'rule_8'
	option name 'Allow-ISAKMP'
	option src 'wan'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest 'lan'
	option dest_port '500'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

# TEMPLATE: requires external secret binding; do not install directly
config wifi-device 'radio0'
	option type 'mac80211'
	option path 'platform/soc@0/c000000.wifi'
	option band '5g'
	option channel '36'
	option htmode 'HE80'

config wifi-device 'radio1'
	option type 'mac80211'
	option path 'platform/soc@0/c000000.wifi+1'
	option band '2g'
	option channel '6'
	option htmode 'HT20'
	option country 'US'
	option cell_density '0'

config wifi-device 'radio2'
	option type 'mac80211'
	option path 'platform/soc@0/c000000.wifi+2'
	option band '5g'
	option channel '100'
	option htmode 'HE80'
	option country 'US'
	option cell_density '0'

config wifi-iface 'default_radio0'
	option device 'radio0'
	option network 'lan'
	option mode 'ap'
	option ssid 'OpenWrt'
	option encryption 'none'
	option disabled '1'

config wifi-iface 'default_radio1'
	option device 'radio1'
	option network 'lan'
	option mode 'ap'
	option ssid '_iot'
	option encryption 'psk2'
	option key '__NETC_SECRET_default_radio1_key__'

config wifi-iface 'wifinet2'
	option device 'radio2'
	option network 'lan'
	option mode 'ap'
	option ssid '_'
	option encryption 'sae'
	option ocv '0'
	option key '__NETC_SECRET_wifinet2_key__'
